tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sbyin sreg bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thab khung du bud shing legs par brtsigs la/ g.yon phyogs su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dmar gtor gsum bsham/ g.yas su yam shing dang*/ mar khu dang*/ chang bzang po la bdud rtsi sbyar ba dang*/ sha lnga tshang ba dang*/ shing gang yang rung ba'i dum bu gtubs pa dang*/ til dang*/ zho dang*/ 'o ma/ mar/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ dūr ba dang*/ ku sha rnams dgod/ rang kha shar du bstan nas 'dug pa'i mdun du/ nang mchod rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs dang bcas pa bzhag nas/ bdag bskyed dang bzlas pa rdzogs par byas la/ thab dang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams la nang mchod nas gtor zhing*/ sumbha'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bud shing gi rtsig pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bskyed nas/ hūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dang*/ bsreg rdzas dpag tu med par bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod cing me sbar nas de'i dbus su ram̐ las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang po dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i gundhe 'dzin pa/

ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ khri snyan sa le'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dmigs nas/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ agna ye e hye hi zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par bstim mo// de nas yang 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs la mchod nas/ 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas de yi ljags las 'od zer byung ba'i nang nas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lan bdun phul nas/ oṃ agna ye zhes kun la sbyar la/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyaṃ pra titstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri mchog badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas dbul lo// de nas 'bar ba'i me la yam shing dang*/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang*/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag dang*/ dūr ba dang ku sha spyi gtsug tu 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ gong gi sngags nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi mthar/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod do// slar yang mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// de nas 'bar ba'i dbus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag bskyed ji 'dra ba bzhin bskyed pa'i mthar rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de rnams la snga ma bzhin du 'di nyid kyi sngags kyis byon zan phul nas/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī zhes kun la sbyar la/ phyi'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// de nas rdzas rnams snga ma'i tshul gyis 'di nyid kyi sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ spel tshig rnams sngar bzhin byas nas mthar yang*/ mar dgang blugs bdun phul la/ slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma'ang phul la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo// de nas yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badzra muḥ zhes brjod nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su me lha dmigs pa la mchod cing bstod nas bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs par phul ba'i mtha' mar dgang blugs bdun phul nas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ agna ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grihne daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes gsum mam/ bdun gyis phul nas/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo// gtor ma gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul lo// de nas oṃ agna ye badzra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyad nas/ lhag ma'i bar gyi cho ga rdzogs par byas la/ smon lam rgya chen po btab nas/ bdag gi gnas gsum bsrungs te/ thal ba chu bo la sogs par dor la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas nas/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa la gnas par bya'o// 'di ltar rtag tu byas na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro// rje sa skya pa'i man ngag las byung ba'i dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di ni go go chen gyis bskul nas/
'phags pas sa mo sbrul gyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po la shang tor sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
